It filters the passed-in episodes by the explicit `seasonNumber`, delegates each one to `markEpisodeWatched`, saves the context, then fetches the full watchlist and calls `NotificationManager.shared.rescheduleEpisodeNotifications(items:)` — matching the save-then-reschedule convention from `refreshAllAiringInfo`.
